verdict.rationale: Kong explicitly documents authentication/authorization plugins supporting JWT, basic auth, OAuth, ACLs, and API keys, applied to upstream APIs, plus mTLS support via its plugin ecosystem and vault-based secret management for credentials. Multiple GitHub and docs sources corroborate this as a core, first-party feature with a quick-start guide dedicated to adding auth in minutes. Missing for 10: explicit first-party doc citation naming mTLS plugin specifically and independent hands-on validation beyond vendor/GitHub descriptions.
